name: ECCV-2024 Data Distillation Challenge
description: Dataset Distillation (DD) seeks to create a condensed dataset that, when used to train a model, enables the model to achieve performance similar to that of a model trained on the entire original dataset. It relieves the model training from processing massive data and thus reduces the computation resources, storage, and time costs. This paper illustrates our solution that ranks 1st in the ECCV-2024 Data Distillation Challenge (track 1). reputation: A specialized ECCV challenge benchmark with strong research interest in dataset distillation, but limited adoption outside the subfield.
notes: Non-LLM vision benchmark; performance depends on the specific distillation protocol and evaluation script, so results are not always directly comparable across papers.
